Data notes · October 26–November 1, 2026
Weekly activity uses Raw Data: 612 leads, 136 tours booked, 56 tours attended, and 17 leases. Lead Data supplies 582 individual records, a 30-record gap versus the weekly summary, and no lease-signed dates for the new week. The gap is Berry Falls 2, Claxton 4, Hills at Hoover 3, Ingleside 14, Lamar 1, Landings 5, and Villa Siena 1. Earlier lead details are retained from the prior dashboard. Detail lists and recorded-cohort results cover only supplied individuals. Exact calendar-month lease totals remain unavailable when signed-date detail does not reconcile to weekly activity. Application counts are blank in the source and remain unavailable. Portfolio occupancy totals require unit counts, which the source does not provide. Spend includes Google Ads, Meta, Zillow, Apartments.com, and Yelp. The existing dashboard policy uses Campaign - Meta for matching property/week records and Expense otherwise: this week Meta campaign spend is $971.43 versus $801.14 in Expense. The resulting dashboard spend is $14,321.70 versus $14,151.41 in Expense; both source amounts are preserved. Google campaign spend is $7,741.39 versus $7,741.38 in Expense, a $0.01 source difference. Meta reports 126 results across 12 campaigns; Landings has a blank result count, so aggregate cost per result is unavailable. Facebook, Instagram, Meta, Meta Ads, Meta Ads Tour, and Paid Social are combined for channel CPL. Weekly rates compare event totals; cohort rates use matching supplied individuals. Reach totals sum campaign-reported values and are not deduplicated. Raw Data assigns the entire October 26–November 1 reporting week to October; October filters therefore show reporting-month totals, not exact calendar-October totals. November goals are not supplied. Benchmark targets, historical close-rate assumptions, property groups, and the Berry Falls exclusion from Lead Goal Pacing totals follow the prior dashboard.

Dynamic Lead Goals
Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Lead Goal ÷ 4.33 weeks  ·  Edit the blue lease goal inputs to see all columns update live  ·  Close Rate = last 4 weeks from View B cohort tracker
Property Monthly Lease Goal
✏️ editable		 4-Wk Close Rate Mo Leads Needed Weekly Goal This Week Leads Gap vs Wk Goal % of Wk Goal Tours Leases Status
📐 Formula: Monthly Lead Goal is editable  ·  Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Lead Goal ÷ 4.33  ·  Lead Gap = Weekly Goal − Actual (negative = ahead)  ·  ✅ ≥ 100% of weekly goal   ⚠️ 80–99%   🔴 < 80%

📐 Lease Goal Formula Reference
% to Goal = Signed Leases ÷ Monthly Lease Goal · Remaining = max(Goal − Signed, 0) · Expected by Now = Monthly Goal × % Month Elapsed · Pace vs Expected = Signed Leases − Expected by Now · Projected EOM = Signed Leases ÷ Days Elapsed × Days in Month. Current-month pacing uses the latest day actually included in the dashboard data.
